notes: Run against the demo extension with a real repo-scoped GitHub token in Secret barn-settings (login codyrancher) and a signed-in claude in the barn-demo-extension pod. Target repository codyrancher/trash.

TWO DEFECTS FOUND THAT ONLY THE CREDENTIALS COULD EXPOSE. (1) A hand-over to a repository the extension did not come from cannot open a pull request: the pod's git history is the seed's, the destination's default branch is its own, and GitHub answers the PR creation with 422 'The barn/demo/1 branch has no history in common with main'. The branch pushes fine; only the PR is refused. handOverForReview() has no step that reconciles the packet's history with the destination, so this is the default outcome for every Studio-seeded extension pushed to a pre-existing repo. To get past it and verify the rest of the chain, codyrancher/trash's main was force-moved to the extension's seed commit 4609f29 (the state an imported extension would be in), the hand-over was repeated, and PR #1 opened normally. main has been restored to 6ddb8036.

(2) The pod-side scripts still resolve the package directory with 'first directory under /app/pkg', which the UI stopped doing. barn-demo-extension holds both /app/pkg/base (left by the old naming bug) and /app/pkg/demo. shell.sh starts tmux with -c /app/pkg/base, so the composer's claude works in base's tree, and barn-provenance.mjs's packageDir() picks base too, so its Stop hook commits into base and its 'report' blames base. Verified directly: 'cd /app/pkg/demo && node /seed/barn-provenance.mjs report' answers base 195e23d5, which is /app/pkg/base's HEAD, not demo's. extensions.ts already fixed its own half (packageDir(name) does a named lookup first and its comment names this exact pod); pod/shell.sh and pod/barn-provenance.mjs did not follow.

ENVIRONMENT, not a product defect: barn-demo-extension's seed ConfigMap was 35 hours stale and had no barn-provenance.mjs at all, so the pod had no provenance hooks. Nothing in the product re-seeds an existing extension - ensureExtension() is only called from create/import/starting - so the file only arrived after visiting /barn/extension/demo/starting, which calls ensureExtension('demo'). The tmux session was then restarted so terminal-tools.sh would register the new hooks. Also repaired: /app/pkg/demo/.git/objects/{4b,8a} were root-owned (created 01:31, before this run, by somebody running git as root in the pod), which made 'git add' fail and silently turned the second hand-over into 'Packet 1 is already at this commit'. chowned back to uid 1000.

Restored afterwards: PR #1 closed, branches barn/demo/1 and barn/demo/2 deleted on GitHub, main back at 6ddb8036, codyrancher/trash left in place; in the pod refs/barn/packets/1+2, both packet branches and refs/notes/barn-provenance removed, /app/pkg/demo reset to 4609f29 and /app/pkg/base reset to 22db7ed, barn-review-demo restored to its pre-run contents, and the barn.rancher.io/repo.demo annotation removed from the Secret. Left in place deliberately: the refreshed seed ConfigMap (23 keys, with barn-provenance.mjs) and /app/.barn/provenance.jsonl, which is the honest record of three real turns.

verdicts.evidence: Opened the publish dialog from the workspace masthead for demo. The 'Push the source to GitHub' row is available with requirement chip 'No sign-off'; the checkbox is not pre-ticked (it starts unchecked, chosen: []), ticking it and confirming opened the second dialog, which read 'pushes that packet to a branch of its own (barn/demo/2) in that repository, and opens a pull request against the default branch'. Entered codyrancher/trash and pressed Publish. GitHub afterwards: branch barn/demo/2 present, pull request #1 'demo: packet 2' open with base main and head barn/demo/2, one file changed (+2 -2), and main untouched at its own tip. So it opens a PR and does not push to the default branch. Caveat recorded in the notes: on the first attempt, against main as the user created it, the push succeeded and the PR was refused 422 for unrelated histories.

Drove the whole hand-off. In the pod: refs/barn/packets/2 and branch barn/demo/2 at 2883651, plus the review record entry in ConfigMap barn-review-demo carrying repo codyrancher/trash and pr {number:1, url:...}. On GitHub: the branch exists and PR #1 is open against main, its body written by handOverForReview ('Handed over from the Rancher Extension Studio as packet 2', collapsed against 288365169a2a, the two outstanding sign-offs, and the no-brief paragraph). packetPullRequest('demo') answered state recorded, sentence 'Packet 2 was handed over as pull request #1.' Screen 11's demo row reads 'Handed over as packet 2 1 minute ago by Default Admin. As pull request #1.' and carries a PR #1 field. Screen 12's chip reads 'PR #1 opened'. publishSummary put 'packet 2 on barn/demo/2, pull request #1' on the status strip rather than the old 'in this cluster only'. The previous fail (no token) no longer holds.

On /barn/review/demo/working the chip [data-testid=rc-pr] read 'PR #1 opened', class s-chip--success s-chip--clickable, title 'Packet 2 was handed over as pull request #1. Opens the pull request.' Clicking it opened a new browser tab at https://github.com/codyrancher/trash/pull/1, captured through the context's page event. Also saw the failed state honestly before the PR existed: the same chip read 'Pull request not opened' with the whole 422 as its title and a 'Press to ask again' affordance.

Opened the import dialog from the Studio masthead with the token stored. Step 1 shows the account handle 'codyrancher' and, under it, the real scopes GitHub returned in the X-OAuth-Scopes header - 'delete:packages · gist · read:org · repo · workflow · write:packages' - and 'expires in 70 days' from the expiry header. All of it comes from githubIdentity() asking a pod, not from anything typed into the page.

Clicked codyrancher/trash in the step 2 list: its row got data-selected=true, computed background rgb(234,244,251) which is exactly #EAF4FB, and an icon-checkmark appeared at its right edge; step 3's 'Name in Studio' changed to 'trash' and the repository field to 'codyrancher/trash'. Then clicked rancher/supportability-review: the selection moved, only one row was data-selected=true, and the name field became 'supportability-review'.

listGithubRepos returned 100 rows. Typing 'trash' narrowed the list to exactly one, codyrancher/trash - so rows that should not match are gone as well as the matching one surviving. Typing 'zzzznope' left zero rows and the note 'None of your 100 repositories match "zzzznope".' Clearing the field brought all 100 back.

Every row carries a visibility icon, a visibility word and a relative time, all read from the GitHub payload: private rows (codyrancher/trash, rancher/supportability-review, rancher/image-scanning) render <i class="s-icon icon icon-lock"> plus 'private', public rows (rancher/rancher, rancher/scans, rancher/os) render the SIcon 'book' name plus 'public'. The updated labels are real and varied across the list - 'Updated today', 'Updated yesterday', 'Updated 2/3/4/5 days ago'. One cosmetic note rather than a defect: SIcon maps 'book' to Rancher's icon-document glyph, since the icon font has no book, so the public marker is a document rather than the book the design draws.

Confirmed with real finished turns, which had never happened in this cluster before (the pod's transcript shows every earlier prompt answered 'Not logged in . Please run /login'). Three prompts sent from the composer produced six blocks in [data-testid=barn-activity-stream]: user turns noted 'Sent from the workspace screen by Default Admin', assistant turns carrying the reply read out of claude's transcript and a meta line of measured fact - 'Finished, and committed what it left behind. · Took 11s · Commit 1ef79ae · Answered on claude-opus-5', with '1 file in this turn's commit'. The honest degraded case rendered too: the third turn, whose edit was outside the tree the hook watches, reads 'Finished. No commit was recorded for it. · Took 4.5s'. [data-testid=barn-stream-stalled] is now absent.

The assistant's own words now appear, not a placeholder: 'Both edits done, nothing else: 1. /app/pkg/base/W7-CREDENTIALED.md - created, single line w7-credentialed check. 2. /app/pkg/demo/pages/Home.vue:13 - heading changed to

It works (w7)

. No git commands run.' Cross-checked against the pod's transcript jsonl, where that is verbatim the assistant message for session 82c400f3.

Opened the publish dialog after the turns: it renders the same six turn blocks, the last being the assistant's reply plus 'Finished. No commit was recorded for it. · Took 4.5s · Answered on claude-opus-5' and the file its editing tools touched. The reply appears above the step list as promised.

With a signed-in claude, a recorded prompt, a Barn-Turn commit and an uncommitted hunk all present at once, screen 12 still could not label the hunk. /barn/review/demo/working showed one hunk for pages/Home.vue and its provenance strip read 'This file is not in the provenance report, so nothing is known about what produced it.' The packet-prompt panel showed the prompt verbatim with 'Prompt 1 of 1 ... 14 minutes ago · from the workspace screen · ended in no commit, so no line can be traced to it'.
verdicts.defect: Two causes, both in the pod scripts rather than in the page. (1) barn-provenance.mjs resolves its tree with readdirSync('/app/pkg')[0], and demo's pod holds /app/pkg/base as well as /app/pkg/demo, so its report is about base: run by hand as 'cd /app/pkg/demo && node /seed/barn-provenance.mjs report' it answers base 195e23d5, which is /app/pkg/base's HEAD. Its Stop hook commits into base for the same reason, and shell.sh starts the pane's claude in /app/pkg/base with the same 'ls -d /app/pkg/*/ | head -1'. extensions.ts fixed exactly this in packageDir(name) and its comment names demo's pod as the case; the two pod scripts were not updated with it. (2) Even with the trees aligned, a hunk can only resolve after the turn's commit exists: report() counts a blame sha of all zeros as unrecorded, so the line an Edit just wrote is unattributable until the Stop hook commits it. The hand-over's own sweep commit ('Uncommitted work, swept in at the hand-over') carries no Barn-Turn trailer, so a change that is swept in rather than committed by a turn is permanently unattributable too.

verdicts.evidence: The authoring half now works: three prompts sent from the composer on screen 03 were captured in /app/.barn/provenance.jsonl with screen 'workspace', principal local://user-btc48 and 'Default Admin', two of them ending in commits whose messages carry Barn-Turn, Barn-Session, Barn-Origin and Barn-Principal trailers, and a PostToolUse touch record per Edit. The per-hunk half does not survive into screen 12: the hunk's strip says 'This file is not in the provenance report'. Packet 2's own note recorded turns: 0, because turnsSince is set to the base commit's timestamp and the base is HEAD (no refs/barn/published/* exists until something is published locally), so every turn that produced the change falls outside the window the packet records.
verdicts.defect: Same root cause as 12-change-hunk-provenance: barn-provenance.mjs and shell.sh pick the first directory under /app/pkg, which in demo's pod is base rather than demo, so the turn commits and the blame index are built against a tree no review screen reads. Secondary: assemblePacket sets turnsSince to state.baseAt, and state.base falls back to HEAD when no baseline ref exists, so the accumulated-prompt window is empty for any extension that has never been published locally - packet 2 recorded turns: 0 despite three real turns minutes earlier. The previous verdict blamed the missing credential; with the credential present the credential is no longer the reason.
